The registries table has a key for each registry, for example: [registries] my-registry = { index = "https://my-intranet:8080/git/index" } The index key should be a URL to a git repository with the registry’s index or a Cargo sparse registry URL with the sparse+ prefix. A crate can then depend on a crate from another registry by specifying the registry key and a value of the registry’s name in that dependency’s entry in Cargo.toml : # Sample Cargo.toml [package] name = "my-project" version = "0.1.0" edition = "2024" [dependencies] other-crate = { version = "1.0", registry = "my-registry" } As with most config values, the index may be specified with an environment variable instead of a config file.
